footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to RB Global: includes $800K of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests; after $46.2M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 7.2% to $4.6B in 2025. Gross margin was 46.4%, versus 46.8% a year earlier, and operating income fell 6.3% to $713M, a 15.5% margin.
Net income rose 2.5% to $382M, or $2.04 per share. Operating cash flow was $978M and free cash flow $719M, versus $765M.
sources: RB Global, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
